description_en: Queries the brute-force attacks prevention rules that you have created

name: DescribeAntiBruteForceRules

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the brute-force attacks prevention rule.
You can invoke the [DescribeAntiBruteForceRules](~~DescribeAntiBruteForceRules~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
防暴力破解规则ID。
调用[DescribeAntiBruteForceRules](~~DescribeAntiBruteForceRules~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示的每页数据的最大条数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the brute-force attacks prevention rule
parameters.name: name

PageInfo.description_en: The pagination information of the query result

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page in a paged query. This parameter is used for paging
Count.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页显示的数据条数

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query. This parameter is used for paging
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page in a paged query. This parameter is used for paging
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页最多显示的数据条数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of brute-force attacks prevention rules that have been created
TotalCount.description_zh: 已创建的防暴力破解规则的总数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Rules.description_en: The details of brute-force attacks prevention rules
Rules.description_zh: 防暴力破解规则详情列表

items.description_en: The details of a brute-force attacks prevention rule

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the brute-force attacks prevention rule was created. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTimestamp.description_zh: 防暴力破解规则创建时间戳。单位：毫秒

DefaultRule.description_en:
Indicates whether the current rule is the default rule. Valid values:
true: The rule is the default rule.
false: The rule is not the default rule.

A brute-force attacks prevention rule that is configured as the default rule takes effect on all servers that do not have a prevention rule configured. See Settings for more information
DefaultRule.description_zh:
当前规则是否为默认规则。取值：
true：是默认规则。
false：不是默认规则。

设置为默认规则的防暴力破解规则会对所有未添加防御规则的服务器生效

EnableSmartRule.description_en: This parameter is deprecated and does not need to be specified
EnableSmartRule.description_zh: 该参数已废弃，无需关注

FailCount.description_en: The threshold for the number of failed logon attempts that triggers the brute-force attacks prevention rule
FailCount.description_zh: 暴力破解防御规则生效的用户登录的失败次数阈值

ForbiddenTime.description_en: The duration for which the attacker IP address is disabled after the brute-force attacks prevention rule is triggered. Unit: minutes
ForbiddenTime.description_zh: 暴力破解防御规则生效后对攻击方IP禁用的时间，单位（分钟）

Id.description_en: The ID of the brute-force attacks prevention rule
Id.description_zh: 暴力破解防御规则的规则ID

MachineCount.description_en: The number of servers to which the brute-force attacks prevention rule is applied
MachineCount.description_zh: 配置该暴力破解防御规则的服务器数量

Name.description_en: The name of the brute-force attacks prevention rule
Name.description_zh: 暴力破解防御规则的名称

ProtocolType.description_en: The protocol types that the brute-force attacks prevention rule supports for interception
ProtocolType.description_zh: 暴力破解规则支持拦截的协议类型

Rdp.description_en:
The RDP interception mode. Valid values:
on: enabled
off: disabled
Rdp.description_zh:
RDP拦截方式，取值：
on：开启
off：关闭

SqlServer.description_en:
The SqlServer interception mode. Valid values:
on: enabled
off: disabled
SqlServer.description_zh:
SqlServer拦截方式，取值：
on：开启
off：关闭

Ssh.description_en:
The SSH interception mode. Valid values:
on: enabled
off: disabled
Ssh.description_zh:
SSH拦截方式，取值：
on：开启
off：关闭

Span.description_en: The time threshold within which the brute-force attacks prevention rule takes effect. Unit: minutes. For example, if Span is set to 10, the brute-force attacks prevention rule is triggered and blocks logon attempts for the specified duration when the number of failed logon attempts within 10 minutes exceeds the settings threshold
Span.description_zh: 暴力破解防御规则生效的时间阈值，单位为分钟。例如span为10，表示如果在10分钟内登录失败次数超过设置的阈值，防暴力破解规则会生效并在指定时间内拦截登录

UuidList.description_en: The list of UUIDs of the servers to which the brute-force attacks prevention rule is applied
UuidList.description_zh: 配置该暴力破解防御规则的服务器的UUID列表

items.description_en: The UUID of a server to which the brute-force attacks prevention rule is applied
items.description_zh: 配置该暴力破解防御规则的服务器的UUID
